photo.alt: Independence monuments and the congress palace in the city

facts: About 837,000 people in the city, 2.19 million in the metropolitan area (2022 census)
On the Gulf of Guinea, at the southwest corner of the country
worth_knowing: The city extends to the Ghana border, a few hundred metres west of the centre. It is Togo's chief port, exporting coffee, cocoa, copra and oil palm kernels.
